name: pathfinder
description: Map an unfamiliar repository, choose the highest-value next move, generate a bounded goal, or run doctrine-gated autonomous mission work.

interface.shortDescription: Map a repo, pick the next move, write the goal
interface.longDescription: Pathfinder opens a chooser for exploring a repo, prompt-to-goal drafting, doctrine-gated autonomous mission runs in an isolated worktree, creator model refresh, and status/help. It reads code first, ranks grounded moves, asks focused Doctrine Interview questions, then saves a bounded Claude Code /goal or fallback implementation goal, or runs /pathfinder auto when the Project Doctrine and clarity gate authorize it.
defaultPrompt: Use the pathfinder skill on this repository. Start the full Pathfinder process.
Map this codebase and propose the highest-value next move.
Generate a bounded /goal for the work we just scoped.
Run Pathfinder autonomously on this repository with /pathfinder auto.
Refresh the Pathfinder creator model with /pathfinder charter.
Turn this prompt into a runnable /goal: <describe the work you want done>.
